extracted.intended_audience: researchers and research administrators at Swiss universities and other institutions applying for or receiving SNSF funding (including early-career researchers)
extracted.subtask_description: High-level institutional guidance and priorities for submitting and managing research grants with the Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF); covers funding priorities, open science, equality and international cooperation. Useful for applicants and host institutions preparing proposals and complying with SNSF policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Excellence of research
rubrics_metrics.description: The Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF) funds excellent research at universities and other institutions – from chemistry to medicine to sociology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SNSF funding is focused on supporting 'excellent research' across disciplines; the homepage emphasizes excellence as the primary funding criterion, though no scoring details are provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open Science requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Open Science: Data and publications must be freely accessible
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SNSF requires that research data and publications be made freely accessible; the page states this as a principle but does not give the detailed open-science policy text here.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open access — publishing
rubrics_metrics.description: Open access: Simple and efficient publishing of results
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SNSF promotes straightforward, efficient open-access publication of research results; applicants should plan for open-access dissemination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Responsible use of AI
rubrics_metrics.description: Artificial Intelligence: For the responsible use of AI
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SNSF highlights responsible AI use as an area of focus/impetus for research; applicants using AI should consider ethical and responsible-use aspects.

rubrics_metrics.name: International cooperation
rubrics_metrics.description: International: Crossing borders with an SNSF grant
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SNSF values worldwide cooperation and supports international collaborations as a basis for research success; applicants can propose cross-border partnerships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equality, diversity and inclusion (EDI)
rubrics_metrics.description: Equality, diversity, inclusion: An open research culture – that’s what we stand for
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SNSF promotes an open research culture grounded in EDI; applicants and institutions are expected to consider and foster equality, diversity and inclusion in projects and teams.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for early-career researchers
rubrics_metrics.description: Early-career researchers: Your scientific career - our funding schemes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SNSF provides targeted funding schemes and support for early-career researchers; applicants at early career stages should consult the relevant schemes and eligibility rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research infrastructures — national planning
rubrics_metrics.description: Research infrastructures: Model for national planning
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SNSF engages in national-level planning for research infrastructures; proposals relying on or contributing to infrastructures should align with national models and planning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency — Data Portal
rubrics_metrics.description: Data Portal: Figures and data for you
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SNSF provides a Data Portal to create transparency with comprehensive information on research projects and key figures; applicants and evaluators can consult it for data and context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guidelines and specific measures for project staff
rubrics_metrics.description: Project staff / Guidelines and specific measures
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SNSF offers guidelines and specific measures relating to project staff (employment terms, measures); applicants and host institutions should follow these rules when planning staffing, though details are not on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: SNSF governance and decision-making
rubrics_metrics.description: SNSF bodies: Who leads the SNSF? Who decides on its funding policy? And who implements it?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Information on governance and bodies that set and implement SNSF funding policy may affect priorities and procedures; applicants should be aware of the foundation's governing structures.
